summary.text: Sigrid Ann Olson, a certified write-in Democratic candidate listed by Spectrum News as living in Cape Elizabeth, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Maine to Troy Jackson, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
No campaign website, statements or Ballotpedia survey were found.

sources.title: Maine's U.S. Senate race to include 6 write-in candidates, triggering ranked-choice voting
